Question: How do I get a trash cart?
Answer: Trash carts are provided FREE to residents in Louisville's Urban Services District. You can request a cart using the Metro311 mobile app (select 'Waste Container Request' > 'New') or by calling 311. You can also request online at louisvilleky.gov/311. The standard size is 95 gallons. Your cart will be delivered to your address within 7-10 business days. The cart remains city property.

Question: What's the weight limit for my trash cart?
Answer: The maximum weight limit for your trash cart is 200 pounds. If your cart is too heavy, the automated lift on the collection truck may not be able to pick it up, and your trash will not be collected. Make sure the lid closes completely - if it doesn't, the cart may be too full or too heavy. Reduce the weight by removing some items or requesting an additional cart via the Metro311 app or by calling 311.

Question: Is there trash pickup on holidays?
Answer: No, there is NO waste collection on Metro Government holidays. These holidays are: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day. When a holiday falls during the week, your collection will be delayed by one day for the rest of that week. Download the Recycle Coach app for automatic holiday schedule alerts.

Question: What happens to my trash schedule when there's a holiday?
Answer: When a Metro holiday falls during the week, all trash, recycling, and yard waste collections are delayed by ONE DAY for the rest of that week. For example, if Monday is a holiday, Monday's route runs on Tuesday, Tuesday's route runs on Wednesday, and so on. Download the free Recycle Coach app or use the Metro311 app to get automatic schedule updates and reminders. You can also call 311 to confirm your adjusted schedule.

Question: Where can I dispose of hazardous waste in Louisville?
Answer: Take household hazardous waste to the Haz Bin at 7501 Grade Lane. Hours: Tuesday-Saturday, 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM. It's FREE for Louisville/Jefferson County residents. Accepted items include: paint, motor oil, batteries, gasoline, cleaners, pesticides, fire extinguishers, fluorescent light bulbs, chemicals, antifreeze, and more. Do NOT put hazardous waste in your regular trash. This facility is for residents only, not businesses. For more information, visit louisvilleky.gov or call 311.

Question: How do I dispose of paint?
Answer: Oil-based paint or lead paint: Take to the Haz Bin at 7501 Grade Lane (Tuesday-Saturday, 9:30 AM-4 PM, FREE for residents). Latex paint: Can go in your regular trash ONLY if the paint is completely dry. To dry latex paint, remove the lid, add kitty litter or sand, let it harden completely, then place in trash with the lid off so collectors can see it's dry. Do NOT pour paint down drains. Call 311 or use the Recycle Coach app for disposal guidance on specific items.
Keywords: paint disposal, dispose paint, old paint, latex paint, oil paint, haz bin

Question: Where can I dispose of batteries?
Answer: Take batteries to the Haz Bin at 7501 Grade Lane (Tuesday-Saturday, 9:30 AM-4 PM, FREE for residents). This includes auto batteries, household batteries (AA, AAA, C, D, 9V), and rechargeable batteries. Do NOT put batteries in your regular trash or recycling - they can cause fires in collection trucks. Many retailers (Best Buy, Home Depot, Lowe's) also accept batteries for recycling. Use the Recycle Coach app to search for disposal options for specific items.

Question: How do I dispose of electronics and e-waste?

Do NOT put electronics in your regular trash - they contain materials that need special recycling. For large appliances (refrigerators, washers, etc.), schedule a pickup via the Metro311 app or call 311.

Question: What time should I put my trash cart out?
Answer: Place your cart at the curb no later than 6:00 AM on your collection day, but no earlier than 4:00 PM the day before collection. Position the cart at the edge of the curb or alley with the arrow on the lid pointing toward the street. Keep the cart at least 3 feet away from other carts, cars, mailboxes, or other objects so the automated lift can access it. Bring your cart back in promptly after collection. Set reminders using the Metro311 app or Recycle Coach app to never miss your collection day.

Question: Can I put my trash out the night before pickup?
Answer: Yes, you can put your trash cart out as early as 4:00 PM the day before your scheduled pickup day. However, it must be out no later than 6:00 AM on collection day. Place the cart at the edge of the curb with the arrow pointing toward the street, at least 3 feet from other objects. Avoid putting carts out too early as they may be knocked over by wind, animals, or vehicles. Bring your cart back in promptly after collection. Use the Metro311 app or Recycle Coach app to track your collection schedule.
